ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens: loose pile of leafy greens with frilly, ruffled edges in bright green, dark purple-red, and speckled burgundy leaves, some broad and flat, some curly; lightly moist with no visible dressing sheen, spread across about one-third of a white square plate, roughly 12 cm across and 3 cm tall at the heap center | 60
ITEM 2 | Cherry tomato half: single bright red, glossy, smooth-skinned piece about 2 cm across, sitting on top of the greens near the upper center of the pile | 10
ITEM 3 | Thin shredded pale yellow-white strands: a few fine, translucent julienned pieces scattered among the greens, about 4 to 5 cm long, moist-looking | 3
